holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection. June 2026 is a burned buffer (already seen in v1–v3 holdout aggregates) and is used for neither selection nor holdout claims.

costs.note: Friction is kept. 10 pt = MT5 points (0.01), not 10 index points. RT ≈ $0.20 slip + ~$0.60 spread. Do not cut slippage to chase 1%/20%.

vol_regime_orb.note: OR close-break only when fast ATR > slow ATR * k (expanding vol). Not an HMM — no sklearn, no fit on this CSV.

tick_proxy_cvd.note: NOT true bid/ask CVD. This repo has no TimescaleDB and M5.hc has tick_volume only. Proxy delta = sign(close-open)*tick_volume, reset each ET day. Fade a structural HH/LH when proxy-CVD fails to confirm.

prior_poc_reversion.note: Prior-ET-day profile from M5 tick_volume distributed across each bar's range (or TPO +1 per overlapping bin). Fade |close-POC|/ATR when the signal bar is below its 20-bar median volume. Target frozen POC.

rank_develop: net>0 and trades>=40; rank by profit_factor then expectancy
note: New search. Not a retune of v1/v2/v3. Do not reopen news-drift. Do not export M1/US500. 1%/day and 20%/month are goals, not promises.
